snippet.title: Volcano Princess Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Volcano Kingdom!
 
A land bristling with swords, spells, alchemy, and lava.
As a father, you will watch over your growing daughter.
 
How will she grow as your many decisions compound?
What secrets do your daughter and the kingdom hold?
 
Volcano Princess is a multiple-ending
princess-raising simulation game
 
On sale July 30, 2026, for iOS, Android, Nintendo Switch, and PS5.
Free updates for Steam release also coming late October!
 
Official Website：https://volcano-princess.com/en/index.html
Official X Account:@VP_OfficialGame（ https://twitter.com/VP_OfficialGame ）
Official Facebook Account:https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61592148410486
